documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Board Meeting Intimation for Consideration And Approval Of The Unaudited Standalone And Consolidated Financial Results Of The Company For The Quarter Ended September 30, 2026.
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: ASK Automotive reported strong financial performance for Q1 FY27, achieving its highest ever quarterly revenue, EBITDA, and PAT with a consolidated revenue growth of 52.1%. Management highlighted robust domestic demand, increased capacity utilization at the Karoli plant, and strategic operational adjustments including the closure of the wheel assembly business. Backed by solid order visibility and new customer supplies, the management upgraded its full-year growth guidance to high teens. ASK Automotive Limited reported its financial and operational performance for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, achieving highest-ever quarterly revenue, EBITDA, and PAT. Consolidated revenue grew by 52.1% year-on-year, driven by volume growth, increasing capacity utilization at Karoli and the new Bangalore facility, and passing through alloy price increases, while offset by the strategic reduction of the wheel assembly business.

guidance.claim: The company upgraded its full-year revenue growth guidance from mid-teens to high-teens.
guidance.quote: We are confident that we will continue to grow not only in mid-teens, but we will be now growing for the full year in high teens.

guidance.claim: Management expects exports to increase by 20% in the current year.
guidance.quote: Last year, we could not go near the target anywhere, but this time, we have given a guidance of 20% increase in the exports, and at the moment, we are still very confident we'll achieve it.

guidance.claim: The company is confident of continuing to grow around mid-teens in FY27.
guidance.quote: We are confident that will continue to grow around mid-teens in FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic demand remains robust and private consumption is resilient.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic demand remains robust, private consumption is resilient, and the Government of India's structural reforms, particularly GST 2.0, continue to energize the broader economy and, importantly for us the automobile sector, given its deep forward and backward linkages.

demand_outlook.claim: The two-wheeler segment recorded production growth of 22.8% on a year-on-year basis in Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: The two-wheeler segment, which is most relevant to us, recorded production growth of 22.8% on a year-on-year basis, with total two-wheeler production of 72.5 lakh units in Q1 FY27, up from 59.50 lakh units in the same quarter last year.

demand_outlook.claim: Management remains optimistic on the medium-term industry outlook supported by improving consumer sentiment and expected benefits from the 8th Pay Commission.
demand_outlook.quote: We also remain optimistic on the medium-term industry outlook, supported by improving consumer sentiment, expected benefits from the 8th Pay Commission, and continued policy support for manufacturing and formalization through labor reforms.

demand_outlook.claim: Management remains optimistic on the medium-term industry outlook supported by improving consumer sentiment and policy support.
demand_outlook.quote: We also remain optimistic on the medium-term industry outlook supported by improving consumer sentiment, expected benefits from the 8th Pay Commission and continued policy support for manufacturing and formalization through labour reforms.

demand_outlook.claim: The independent aftermarket grew by 24.7% in FY26 due to the GST rate reduction.
demand_outlook.quote: Happy to share that our independent aftermarket has grown by 24.7% in FY26.

capex_expansion.claim: The second captive solar plant of 11.55 megawatts at Bikaner, Rajasthan is expected to be commissioned in Q2FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Our second captive solar plant of 11.55 megawatts at Bikaner, Rajasthan is ready and is expected to be commissioned in Q2FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: Full-year capex is expected to reach around Rs. 700 crore due to the need to set up a new plant in the South.
capex_expansion.quote: We had given guidance about around Rs. 450 crore to Rs. 500 crore, but the way we are going and receiving the orders, as I today revised the guidance to high-teens, I think our capex may go to something like Rs. 700 crore this year.

capex_expansion.claim: A new plant in Bangalore, South will be set up on a war footing to be operationalized before March.
capex_expansion.quote: That is the need that we have to urgently set up for the new orders that have come. We have to set up a new plant in South, that will be in Bangalore at a war footing, and we hope to operationalize it before March in this financial year.

capex_expansion.claim: The company operationalized a 9.9 MWp Solar Power Plant for captive consumption.
capex_expansion.quote: 9.9 MWp Solar Power Plant for captive consumption operationalized.

capex_expansion.claim: The company will be investing around Rs. 400 Cr for next year's growth.
capex_expansion.quote: For next year growth of mid-teens, we need to invest around RS.400 Cr which we shall be investing in this year also.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated EBITDA for Q1 FY27 stood at Rs. 164 crore representing 32.7% year-on-year growth.
margins_costs.quote: We achieved EBITDA of Rs. 164 crore with 32.7% year-on-year growth.

margins_costs.claim: Aluminum prices are expected to remain benign in coming quarters leading to anticipated improvements in EBITDA margins.
margins_costs.quote: However, with aluminum prices expected to remain benign in the coming quarters, we anticipate an improvement in our EBITDA margins.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins stood at 12.0% for Q1 FY27.
EBITDA margin for Q4 FY26 was 12.1% and was impacted by pass-through alloy prices.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin at 12.1%, however, this EBITDA percentage was impacted due to pass-through alloy prices as mentioned earlier.

margins_costs.claim: For FY26, the company achieved an EBITDA of Rs. 551 Cr with an EBITDA margin of 13.1%.
margins_costs.quote: We achieved EBITDA of Rs. 551 Cr with 24.1% year-on-year growth. EBITDA margin at 13.1%, however, EBITDA percentage was impacted due to pass-through alloy prices.

margins_costs.claim: The strategic reduction in the low-margin wheel assembly business is now complete, and wheel assembly revenue will be nil from 1st April 2026.
margins_costs.quote: Another key update, strategic reduction in low margin wheel assembly business is now complete. From 1st April 2026, wheel assembly revenue will be nil.

orders_capacity.claim: Confirmed orders for alloy wheels stand at about Rs. 70 crore to Rs. 90 crore for the current financial year and about Rs. 250 crore for the next financial year.
orders_capacity.quote: We have confirmed orders of about Rs. 70 crore to Rs. 90 crore depending on how the customer gear up for this financial year. However, for next financial year, we have confirmed orders of about Rs. 250 crore.

orders_capacity.claim: Export revenue from Ford Motors is expected to be about Rs. 40 to Rs. 45 crore this year and go up to Rs. 60 crore next year.
orders_capacity.quote: As regards your second question of Ford Motors, we will be doing exports of about Rs. 40 to Rs. 45 crore this year, and next year, it is likely to go up to Rs. 60 crore.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization at the Karoli plant has gone up from 60% to 65% in the last quarter to about 75%.
orders_capacity.quote: happy to share that against the installed capacity in Karoli plant, from 60% to 65% that we were in the last quarter, we have now gone up to about 75%, and we are confident that in the last Q4, we will be around 80% of the capacity utilization, because we see the visibility for the Q4.

orders_capacity.claim: The technical collaboration with Kyushu Yanagawa Japan has been successfully implemented at the Karoli plant, and the first supply of high pressure die casted alloy wheels has started to a leading Japanese customer.
orders_capacity.quote: Happy to share that the technical collaboration with Kyushu Yanagawa Japan has been successfully implemented at our Karoli plant and 1st Supply of High Pressure Die Casted Alloy Wheel has started to our leading Japanese customer.
Very, very happy to share that Bangalore we have reached 90% capacity utilization that we set up last year, our 18th plant and the third plant in Bengaluru.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization at the Karoli plant is currently 65%.
orders_capacity.quote: In the Karoli plant, the capacities utilization is still 65%, that is the reason that we have made investment for the alloy wheels.

capital_allocation.claim: Internal accruals will be utilized for funding capex, supplemented by external term loans for machines.
capital_allocation.quote: We are actually keeping in mind our high mid-teen growth, our internal accruals will be sufficient; but yes, for cash flow management, we will have to take some external financing.

capital_allocation.claim: Management remains confident that the debt-to-equity ratio will remain under control and not exceed 0.5.
capital_allocation.quote: We are still very confident that our debt equity will remain under control and it will be not exceed 0.5.

capital_allocation.claim: The board has recommended a dividend of 92.5%, amounting to Rs. 1.85 per equity share.
capital_allocation.quote: The board has recommended a dividend of 92.5%, that is Rs. 1.85 per equity share of face value of Rs. 2 each.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical conflicts in West Asia created undue volatility in energy, commodity, and currency markets, causing a sharp increase in aluminum alloy prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: As you are aware, after 28th February 2026, the geopolitical conflict in West Asia had created undue volatility in energy, commodity, and currency markets, and had led to a sharp, phenomenal increase in aluminum alloy prices, which affected our industry.

risks_headwinds.claim: Volatility in alloy prices may affect margin percentages due to the denominator effect.
risks_headwinds.quote: Volatility in alloy prices may affect margin percentages due to the denominator effect.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical conflicts in West Asia have disrupted the global economy and caused undue volatility in energy, commodity, and currency markets.
risks_headwinds.quote: After 28th February, 2026, geopolitical conflict in West Asia has disrupted the global economy, posing an unprecedented challenge in supply chain, creating undue volatility in energy, commodity and currency across the globe and it has started affecting Indian economy as well.

risks_headwinds.claim: Revenue from exports declined to Rs. 141 Cr in FY26 due to trade disruptions, higher tariff rates, geopolitical tensions, and supply chain issues.
risks_headwinds.quote: Our revenue from exports were at Rs. 141 Cr in FY26 against Rs. 147 Cr last year because of the trade disruptions due to higher tariff rates, geopolitical tensions, supply chain issues, logistic costs and other bottlenecks.

management_commitments.claim: The second captive solar plant in Bikaner, Rajasthan is expected to be commissioned in Q2FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Our second captive solar plant of 11.55 megawatts at Bikaner, Rajasthan is ready and is expected to be commissioned in Q2FY27.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to operationalize the new plant in Bangalore before March of the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: We have to set up a new plant in South, that will be in Bangalore at a war footing, and we hope to operationalize it before March in this financial year.

management_commitments.claim: Initial supplies for the sunroof cables business will start from H2.
management_commitments.quote: Initial supplies will start from H2, but next year, you will see substantial growth there.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to invest around Rs. 400 Cr in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: For next year growth of mid-teens, we need to invest around RS.400 Cr which we shall be investing in this year also.

management_commitments.claim: Alloy wheel revenue for FY27 is expected to be around Rs. 90 to Rs. 100 Cr.
management_commitments.quote: FY27 we are expecting revenue of around Rs. 90 - Rs. 100 Cr and FY28 will be about Rs. 220 Cr.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
